column2: added touch controls for a phone: drag-to-steer pad, auto-accelerate, DRIFT, BRAKE, PAUSE and RESET buttons, tap to start; IT marker made small over your own roof
renamed the game from Siren Tag to Crash Out: Houston Edition, on the title screen, the page and the brief; the town is Houston

thumb control is now a full directional pad (forward to go, back to brake and reverse, sideways to steer; auto-accelerate and the BRAKE button removed); the map is open: only buildings, palm trunks and the fountain are solid, blocks are grass lots and parks you can drive across, kerbs are low

added a vehicle choice on the title screen (ambulance, fire engine or cruiser; the other two are bots); fire engine made easy: fire_turn 0.82 to 1.08, fire_accel 11 to 15, fire_top 24.5 to 25, collides at 85% of its drawn size, camera sits further back for longer vehicles

milestone 1 of the roadmap: fourth rig (Humvee), per-rig handling and terrain (pavement, dirt, water), the bayou with a paved arched bridge and a dirt low-water crossing, downtown skyline, 2 or 3 bots, safe ring, phone HUD, camera kept out of buildings and under tall palms, bot driving reworked (three-circle collisions, T-junction braking, handbrake and three-point turns, jam escape)

column2: round_time 70 to 120; bots 2-3 to 2-7 (default 5), eight seats with two of each rig; bot driver rewritten (interception, shortest-path chase with line-of-sight shortcuts, layer-aware bridge chasing, smarter fleeing, dodging in every round, handbrake corners); bot speed r1 0.78 to 0.94, r2 0.9 to 1.0, r3 1.0 to 1.04, steering r1 0.65 to 0.92, r2 0.85 to 1.0, lead 0/0.5/1 to 0.6/0.9/1.1, corner speed 12 to 15, new bot_player_bias 12

fixed bots circling at the map edge: fleeing bots no longer bolt for the far corners (distance benefit capped, dead ends and corners penalised harder), they cruise round blocks at 60% speed while IT is far away, plan turns earlier at speed, and brake for a target inside their turning circle; new bot_cruise 0.6

added Battle Royale: mode picker, three-minute match scored on wrecks, blaster with visible bolts, 16 ammo crates on paved and dirt routes, health, ram damage, wreck credit, respawn with protection, results with Rematch and Change Mode, FIRE button on a phone; bot brains split per mode with a crossing intercept in Tag and ammo seeking, shot line-up, break-off and bot-on-bot fights in Battle Royale; handling values unchanged

column2: added private-room multiplayer for Patient Tag: server.js (the game script run headless, one simulation per room, hand-written WebSocket, no packages), Create Room and Join Room on the title, a lobby with code and invite link, rig choice with duplicates, host start, shared round result, client prediction and smoothing, held seat and reconnect, rematch; solo and Battle Royale unchanged

column2: fixed the game overflowing the screen inside the Claude phone app: it now sizes itself to the visible window less the padding the host page keeps for its bars, and re-fits on rotation and viewport changes

the town now draws across the whole visible area (no black strips at the sides of a wide phone), with the HUD centred in its 16:9 layout and the thumb controls moved out towards the real edges; a FULL SCREEN button on the title where the browser allows one; home-screen app tags
